title: Great Stink
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Great Stink", at revision 1381900566, opens: "The Great Stink was an event in Central London during July and August 1858 in which the hot weather exacerbated the smell of untreated human waste and industrial effluent that was present on the banks of the River Thames. The problem had been mounting for several years, with an ageing and inadequate sewer system that emptied directly into the Thames. It was thought that the miasma from the effluent transmitted contagious diseases, and three outbreaks of cholera before the Great Stink were blamed on the ongoing problems with the river." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q546233, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "event in central London in July and August 1858". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
